verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI outputs data in open, portable formats (Markdown, JSON via schemas) and is fully open-source with no forced API keys or paywalls, letting users take their extracted data and self-host freely. However, this is about export of crawler output, not a full 'export all your data and leave' migration story with account/data portability tooling. missing for 10: no evidence of a formal data-export/account-portability feature, no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec confirming open interoperable schemas (probes show 404s), and no explicit migration/backup tooling beyond markdown/JSON output.
